candidate.de: Orjen Riđanović (solo gitara) i Hrvoje Sudar (ritam gitara) čine Oridano Duet, sastav koji kroz autentičan zvuk spaja mediteranski senzibilitet s naslijeđem gypsy jazza i inspiracijom Djanga Reinhardta, jednog od pionira europske jazz gitare.
candidate.en: Orjen Riđanović (solo guitar) and Hrvoje Sudar (rhythm guitar) form the Oridano Duo, a band that through authentic sound combines Mediterranean sensitivity with the legacy of gypsy jazz and the inspiration of Django Reinhardt, one of the pioneers of European jazz guitar.
candidate.fr: Orjen Riđanović (guitare solo) et Hrvoje Sudar (guitare rythmique) forment le duo Oridano, un groupe qui par son son authentique réunit la sensibilité méditerranéenne avec l'héritage du jazz manouche et l'inspiration de Django Reinhardt, l'un des pionniers de la guitare de jazz européenne.
candidate.hr: Orjen Riđanović (solo gitara) i Hrvoje Sudar (ritam gitara) čine Oridano Duet, sastav koji kroz autentičan zvuk spaja mediteranski senzibilitet s naslijeđem gypsy jazza i inspiracijom Djanga Reinhardta, jednog od pionira europske jazz gitare.
candidate.it: Orjen Riđanović (chitarra solo) e Hrvoje Sudar (chitarra ritmica) formano il duo Oridano, un gruppo che attraverso un suono autentico unisce la sensibilità mediterranea con il lascito del jazz manouche e l'ispirazione di Django Reinhardt, uno dei pionieri della chitarra di jazz europea.
candidate.sl: Orjen Riđanović (solo kitaro) in Hrvoje Sudar (ritmična kitaro) tvorita Oridano Duo, skupina, ki skozi avtentičen zvok združuje mediteransko občutljivost z nasledstvom gipske jazze in inspiracijo Djangoja Reinhardta, enega od pionirjev evropske jazza kitar.
candidate.venue: Atrij Gradske vijećnice Korčula

candidate.de: The major religious event of the year in Čara, centred on the church of Gospa od Carskog Polja in the field below the village. A traditional procession draws villagers and visitors from across the island.
candidate.en: Sveti Jakov pilgrimage (25 July) — the major religious event of the year in Čara, centred on the church of Gospa od Carskog Polja in the field below the village. A traditional procession draws villagers and visitors from across the island.
candidate.venue: Gospa od Carskog Polja (Our Lady of Čara Field), Carsko Polje below the village

candidate.en: Kumpanija — Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.
candidate.venue: Carsko Polje

candidate.en: Harvest season — the grape harvest in Carsko Polje in September and early October is one of the most visually striking seasonal events on the island, with the whole field in activity. Wine production at the cooperative cellar follows immediately after.
candidate.venue: Carsko Polje

candidate.de: Step aboard our 1941 traditional wooden boat for an authentic sea experience. Discover secluded coves, homemade local food, cold drinks, towels, snorkeling gear and stories passed down through generations. More than a boat tour—it’s the smell of homemade food, the taste of local wine and the sound of the sea and stories passed down through generations.
